notes.title: Patch Notes – V1.236
notes.notes:
🌐 Language Support Update


 Fixed text and font issues related to the Vietnamese language.

notes.title: V1.22 - Update Notes
notes.notes:
Added option to change Speaker Mode (Mono, Stereo, Surround 5.1, Surround 7.1).
 Various improvements and optimizations.

notes.title: Patch Notes – V1.2
notes.notes:
🛠️ Fixes & Improvements 


 Resolved font rendering issues in some languages.
 Various bug fixes and performance improvements.

notes.title: Update Notes – V1.16
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where DLSS settings caused in-game computer screen to appear blurry.

notes.title: Update Notes – V1.14
notes.notes: Minor bug fixes have been implemented.

notes.title: Update Notes - V1.12
notes.notes: Fixed a rare bug that occurred during saving and loading. The save system is now more stable.

notes.title: V1.07 Patch
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that prevented the game from opening when corrupt save files were present.

notes.title: EA_V0.93 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
🆕 Onboarding Update


 The onboarding process is now more detailed and user-friendly. A better guide for new players!


🛠 Bug Fixes


 Minor bug fixes for a smoother gameplay experience.

notes.title: EA_V0.85 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
🔧 Bug Fixes: 


 Fixed an issue where parts could disappear during assembly and disassembly.  
 Fixed a bug that caused slipping while screwing.

notes.title: New Job System Update!
notes.notes:
🆕 Repair Up to 5 Devices at Once!


It’s time to boost your workshop’s efficiency! Now you can repair up to 5 devices simultaneously. This new feature allows you to complete jobs faster and manage your repair processes more effectively. More devices, more repairs, more profit! 🔧⚡
